Notes.Text:
This update for python-jwcrypto fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-92091: `JWK.import_key()` validates the `key_ops` JWK member for duplicate values using a quadratic
  complexity algorithm, which allows attackers to cause a denial of service via excessive resource consumption
  (bsc#1280816).

Vulnerabilities.Description: A flaw was found in jwcrypto. The JWK.import_key() function validates the key_ops JWK member for duplicate values using an algorithm with O(n^2) time complexity, and the length of key_ops is not bounded. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can supply a JWK with a large key_ops array to an application that passes attacker-controlled key material to a public key-import API (reachable via ECDH-ES key agreement, OIDC dynamic client registration, DPoP, or ACME account key registration, among others) to consume excessive CPU time, resulting in a denial of service.
